svg.title: Choose the Offer, Build Trust, Earn the Referral
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-recurring-offer-to-trusted-referral; chapter number: 1; title: Choose the Offer, Build Trust, Earn the Referral; subtitle: Match recurring economics to buyer intent before introducing the affiliate offer.; caption: Michael Bashi favors recurring software commissions; Adam Enfroy connects search demand, commissions, and competitive weaknesses; Brian Brewer demonstrates capture and introduction.; assumptions note: This sequence combines Michael Bashi, Adam Enfroy, Smart Capital, Brian Brewer, and Cesar O. Vlogs. It is not a single campaign with a shared earnings result or completion deadline.; note: Cesar O. Vlogs reports a year to their first commission. Smart Capital emphasizes retention, attribution windows, and refund terms rather than the headline commission alone.; chart type: process_flow; stages: step: 01; label: Match a buyer problem; value: Step 1; detail: Adam Enfroy looks for the intersection of search demand, good commissions, and weaknesses that better content can address.; step: 02; label: Inspect recurring economics; value: Step 2; detail: Michael Bashi favors useful subscription software with recurring monthly affiliate payments.; step: 03; label: Check retention and terms; value: Step 3; detail: Smart Capital compares customer retention and checks cookie windows and refunds before counting earnings.; step: 04; label: Capture and introduce; value: Step 4; detail: Brian Brewer demonstrates lead capture, a personal introduction, and automated selling around an audience-aligned offer.; step: 05; label: Nurture with useful email; value: Step 5; detail: Cesar O. Vlogs includes value-only emails without links rather than making every message a promotion.
